Hi! Long time no see! After about 10 years [of dormancy](/about/history.qmd), [dfolio(at)free](/)
website is up again.
But, as you see, mainly in [English](/about/index.qmd#langage).
:::
::: {.content-visible unless-profile="free"}
Hi everyone!
:::
I like many aspects of web design, development, code front end designing of
websites...
However, I am neither a web designer nor a developer. 
I am just interested in these topics... as a '_hobby_'. 
So all development and design are made when I have time.
You can also have a look to the notice on the [license](/about/license.qmd) and the [cookies-consent](/about/privacy.qmd#cookie) using the left sidebar.

## Goals

The [dfolio]' website aims to:

- share my activities as associate professor, that is [research](/research/index.qmd) and [teaching](/teaching//index.qmd) activities
- be a place to centralize new scientific, technological,  development topics and miscellaneous stuff that I gave found/discovered

## Langage

I am French, and my mother tongue is French. But, I have chosen to write mainly
this new version of [dfolio]' website in English. Why? Obviously for a wide spreading of
its contents.
